placeholders.bootstrap.seed: filled in (20261101) but provisional; the committed seed is registered with the final analysis
placeholders.night_token_cap: filled in (16384) but provisional; set during development, frozen at the Nov 1 freeze
placeholders.replay_token_penalty: 2026-10-28: 0.01 chosen a priori on fakes (a night spent to the 20,000-token cap then costs 0.2, a tenth of the Brier score's range of 2), not set on development; to be confirmed on development lives before the Nov 1 12:00 ET registration
placeholders.nights_per_life_final: set at the Nov 1 freeze, before the reveal (null until then)
placeholders.human_check.sample_seed: set at the Nov 1 freeze, before the reveal (null until then)

collapse.judged_as: dragged into the field or not
collapse.scope: prompts outside the person's field (prompt domain not in the person's field_domains)

scoring.order: both orders; a flipped verdict is a tie
scoring.taste_ab: log-probability forced choice, both orders, no judge

blocks.new_work: one held-out item with every probe derived from it
blocks.taste_ab: one held-out item with every probe derived from it; a shared taste_ab item is one block across both lives of the matched pair, resampled jointly

bootstrap.interval_scope: the interval covers these 3 lives' probes, conditional on these lives; it is not a population estimate, and the README says so
bootstrap.source: a paired bootstrap that resamples within each (life, kind): held-out source blocks for new_work and taste_ab (a block is one held-out item with every probe derived from it), and single probes for vocab, tone_hold and pushback. 10,000 resamples, committed seed (5.1b)

win.life_ahead_when: its own tie-inclusive score is above 0.50
win.single_life_vs_3x: field check: reported, never needed for a claim row
win.unpromoted_donor: counts as not ahead on 3 vs 3x and is left out of the pooled 3x score and CI; stated as inconclusive
win.source: Final, per dimension, arm 3 against arm 1 and arm 3 against arm 3x (5.1b). Knowledge (new_work + vocab) and interaction (tone_hold + taste_ab) are claimed separately; neither carries the other (5.1).
win.scored_unit: each (comparison, dimension) is judged on its own with the full rule: CI lower bound, overall score, decisive share and lives ahead

loss: the same rule in the other direction

comparisons.note: byte-identical context; only the adapter differs
2F prompt length and per-turn prefill cost reported beside it; if the raw evidence passes 131k tokens 2F keeps the newest items and records what it dropped

each_comparison_rule.win: every registered win condition: CI lower bound above 50%, overall at least 55%, decisive share at least 58%, ahead in at least 2 of the 3 lives
each_comparison_rule.loss: the same rule in the other direction
each_comparison_rule.matches: 95% CI lower bound of arm 4's score above 45% without a win
each_comparison_rule.inconclusive: everything else; never called matches; a lower bound at or below 45% is never a match
each_comparison_rule.excludes: the matched-pair condition and the donor rules do not apply; arm 3x is not involved

fairness.matches_wording: matches the best memory, within five points
fairness.source: 'Matches the best memory, within five points' is said only when the 95% CI lower bound of arm 4's score against 2C is above the registered margin, 45%. Otherwise it's reported as measured, and 'inconclusive' never becomes 'matches'. (5.1)

claim_table.applied: to each dimension separately; the first matching row wins

rows.when: 3 wins against both 1 and 3x, and both matched-pair lives are ahead against 3x
rows.claim: With every note removed, her own weights [know her world / talk her way] better than the base model, and better than another person's trained weights, on 3 lives drawn after the code froze.

rows.when: 3 wins against 1; against 3x it is inconclusive or a loss
rows.claim: With every note removed, sleep made her weights better than the base model at [her kind of work / the way she wants to be talked to]. Against another person's trained weights it was [inconclusive / a loss], so we don't claim it learned her in particular.
A week of nightly training didn't make her weights measurably better [in knowledge / in interaction] without notes. Here is exactly what we measured.

qualifiers.when: a knowledge win did not survive style-neutral re-judging
qualifiers.claim: once style was flattened, the result was [win / inconclusive / loss], so we don't claim it's substance

qualifiers.when: a comparison the Gemini judge scored as a loss
qualifiers.claim: a second judge from another model family disagreed, with both numbers
the measured cost per person per month at the registered configuration; over the ceiling the wording is: her weights learned, but not yet at a viable cost ($X a month)
4 against 2C and 4 against 2F on new_work, each as win, loss, inconclusive or matches, beside 2F's prompt length and cost per turn

hand_written.founder_and_researcher_pairs_taste_ab: Development personas only: the 16 shared taste_ab items of the founder pair and of the researcher pair were written by hand (Claude, as the build worker), not by a Muse Spark call. The final lives' taste_ab items come from the isolated Muse Spark call that sees only the pair's field (5.1). Held-out items were meaning-checked twice against the visible part; development results may still overstate generalization, which is why the headline comes only from held-out lives.
hand_written.film_pair: The film student pair was retired before any of its data existed.

checkpoint_rule.scored: the checkpoint serving after each life's last night: the last promoted one, or the base model if no night was promoted (reported as such)
checkpoint_rule.code: final lives run from a separate checkout of the sleep-freeze tag; a run on any other code is refused
checkpoint_rule.rerun: allowed only for an infrastructure failure while no score file exists for that life; once a score exists the refusal is absolute; any rerun is logged and stated in the README
checkpoint_rule.output: scoring output goes to the prereg branch as is
checkpoint_rule.source: What is scored: the checkpoint serving after each life's last night. That's the last promoted one, or the base model if no night was promoted, which is reported as such. It is never the best night. (5.1b)

donor_rule.draw: one pair plus one single life from a different pair; the single life's field differs
donor_rule.single_life_3x: a field check (that donor is from another field); reported, never needed for a claim row
donor_rule.fixed: the donor map is a pure function of the draw and the rule; it is fixed at the draw and logged there; donors never change after the draw
donor_rule.dev_lives: the founder pair and the researcher pair; each pair's members are each other's 3x, registered Oct 27 before the draw (personas-v2)
donor_rule.arms_reply_refuses: any donor other than the registered one
donor_rule.source: The pair's members are each other's 3x, so the control is a same-field donor that learned the opposite taste... the single life's donor is the drawn pair's first member; that donor is from another field, so the single life's 3x result is reported as a field check (5.1)

human_check.blind: with the brief, arms hidden, order randomized
human_check.source: Kevin blind-rates 30 randomly drawn final pairs from 3 against 1 and 3 against 3x, with the brief, arms hidden and order randomized. The judge-human agreement is reported. (5.1)

judging.judge: Muse Spark with judge_v1.md; reads the person's judge brief including held-out preferences; answers A, B or tie; taste_ab never goes to a judge
judging.orders: each pair judged in both orders; a flipped verdict is a tie; ties count half

second_judge.scope: every final pair, synthetic people only
second_judge.report: agreement with Muse Spark per life and per dimension; every disagreement shown prominently, not only significant reversals
second_judge.source: Agreement with Muse Spark is reported per life and per dimension, and every disagreement is shown prominently, not only significant reversals. (5.1)

style_neutral.rewrite: Muse Spark with neutral_v1.md, both replies into the same plain voice under 150 words, keeping every point and suggestion, then judged again
style_neutral.reading: a knowledge win that survives is diagnostic evidence it isn't tone, length or confidence alone; a win that doesn't survive proves nothing either way
style_neutral.source: It isn't run on interaction probes, where style is what's measured. (5.1)

requires_both: a win row of the claim table
measured cost under the ceiling at the registered configuration
working_product.over_ceiling_wording: her weights learned, but not yet at a viable cost ($X a month)
working_product.video: does not call it a working product when the cost is over $10 a month
working_product.source: A win at a configuration over $10 a month is worded 'her weights learned, but not yet at a viable cost ($X a month)', and the video doesn't call it a working product. (5.1)

no_win_fallback.claim: the product's measured value is the night agent's work and the MIND results (Task 17, then Task 16), each credited to what produced it, and the video leads with MIND (4)
no_win_fallback.source: If neither dimension wins, the product's measured value is the night agent's work and the MIND results (Task 17, then Task 16), each credited to what produced it, and the video leads with MIND (4). (5.1)

credit_separation: homework and any held note show the night agent's work (Wonder); choices show her state's work (MIND); neither is evidence that the weights learned
registered_before_seed_reveal: hashes of every prompt (probe, brief, judge, neutral, life expansion, decider, relevance)
probe counts per kind and dimension
Task 16 outcome definitions, horizon and p_needed estimator
